senses.zh_definition: 汉考克：姓氏 Hancock 的常见中文音译；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname; the particular bearer or named entity must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Hancock; orang atau entiti yang dimaksudkan perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 词类 noun 在此涵盖专有名词，并不表示它是马来语普通名词。姓氏资料见 [Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 提供](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/hancock)。以下为姓名使用结构示例，不宣称是高频固定搭配；例句人物为示例。

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names gives an English origin from the personal name Hann with the affectionate suffix -cok. It also records a Dutch origin associated with a word for a periwinkle, possibly an occupational surname. These are historical surname explanations; neither establishes a Malay root or identifies a particular bearer. Source: [Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/hancock).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Hancock 与“汉考克”的姓名牌配对记忆；整词记姓氏，不拆成马来语词根。
